integrity: The theorem has a uniform analytic proof. A deterministic exhaustive checker independently compares the theorem criterion with direct zero forcing closure for every subset for 3 <= p,q <= 6. The finite computation corroborates but does not replace the proof. The accessible full text of the zero forcing polynomial paper was inspected; the cut-vertex paper was only available through abstract/bibliographic material, which is recorded as a residual coverage risk for the scalar value.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the graph formed by two cliques of orders p,q >= 3 joined by one bridge edge. No claim is made for smaller clique orders, longer connecting paths, forcing variants, minimum rank, or maximum nullity. General cut-vertex theory may already imply the scalar zero forcing number; the retained contribution is the all-set complement characterization and resulting enumeration.
title: Zero forcing sets of one-edge barbell graphs
